how_to_run: Makes fixtures, not a gate (Task 1 Step 2). Run on the 9.1.0 plugin from a temporary worktree at commit 5356c73cd: `python3 run_eval.py <out> G1 --runs 1 --plugin <v91-worktree>/plugins/handsonai --evals evals-generate-9x.json`. G1 carries the 9.1.0 I1 interview output (fixtures/upgrade-9x-generated/I1) through 9.1.0 Design, Build and Test's opener; each session's snapshot becomes a stage fixture: session 1 -> I1-designed, session 2 -> I1-built, session 3 -> I1-test-in-progress. G2 continues from I1-test-in-progress through the remaining Test runs and Run, for I1-running. The expectations only confirm each stage was reached. G2 starts from I1-test-installed (I1-test-in-progress with the built skills copied into .claude/skills/, as the student does by hand; the AI can't write there in -p mode); its sessions are built from G1's inputs: one run chat per test input (each graded in its own chat, as 9.1.0 Test hands them over), the opener again to close the round, then Run; its last snapshot becomes I1-running. The run chats get WebSearch and WebFetch (tools: web), since the built skill researches the prospect. Result: G2 closed the round with a Not ready verdict (a real outcome on 9.1.0), so Run refused to start and there is no I1-running stage; U4-gen was dropped (U4 on the frozen worked example covers an in-production 9.1.0 workflow).
